concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-capital-additional-financing]] — 2026-09-15 pilot Capital renewal conditions versus a new grant after full repayment, including age/repayment/currency/offer gates, renewed ToS, fee/principal mechanics and UI/API paths with divergent minimum wording.
warnings: Pilot scope and per-grant eligibility do not establish current country access, a formal accepted offer, actual repayment or funding.

The general eligibility table requires an offer at least 150% of prior outstanding balance, while the UI section says minimum loan amount is outstanding balance plus EUR 500/equivalent; the page does not reconcile these thresholds.
Atomic reservation, unpaid prior-fee waiver and effectively available funds are described mechanisms, not a real user's settled accounting or bank-receipt proof.
